Hello Sam + Ruth,

Thanks again for taking time with our team last week. We'd like to formalize a short mutual action plan (MAP) so we can run a focused evaluation and get you to a production decision within a predictable window. I pulled together a draft MAP (attached) and a proposed close timeline below.

High level proposal
- Goal: Complete technical evaluation, security review, and procurement review to reach PO/commitment.
- Target close: 6 weeks from kickoff (target: 2026-04-09).
- Key milestones: Technical kickoff -> Evaluation run -> Quality sign-off -> Procurement + Contracting -> Go/No-go decision.

Suggested roles
- Bluefin exec sponsor: Sam Keller (you) — commercial/regulatory owner
- Bluefin engineering lead: please confirm — will own test dataset and infra decisions
- Redwood SE/ML: Marcus Lin — technical lead for model running and metrics
- Redwood AE/ops: me — commercial and MAP owner

Ask
1) Please confirm your primary engineering contact to include on the technical kickoff (we expect an engineering lead + one SWE).
2) Are there standing windows next week for a 60-minute technical kickoff (Marcus will drive agenda)?
3) Any non-negotiable security or residency constraints we should be aware of up front?

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.pdf (one-page timeline + milestones)

If that looks good I'll get a calendar invite out with the agenda.

Thanks,

— Stephanie Nguyen

Hi Sam / Ruth — Marcus here, I'm the SE who will run the technical portion of the evaluation. Quick notes on what I'd like to cover in the kickoff so we can keep the evaluation tight and measurable: 

Proposed 60-minute tech kickoff agenda (high level)
- 0-10: Introductions & success criteria (what does a win look like?)
- 10-25: Architecture review — where will inference run (VPC / cloud region / on-prem)? data flow & security controls
- 25-40: Evaluation plan — dataset, target latency/throughput, quality metrics (ROUGE/BLEU or human eval), pass/fail thresholds
- 40-55: Test environment & access — sandbox credentials, sample payloads, monitoring hooks
- 55-60: Next steps & MAP milestone owners

Things I need from Bluefin before the kickoff
- Confirm engineering lead + one SWE to attend
- Short description of your test dataset (size, privacy constraints)
- List of any compliance evidence you will need (SOC 2, encryption at rest, etc.)

I can bring a one-page tech checklist and a small runbook that covers how we'll stage a 1k-10k token workload on our Dedicated sandbox. Two proposed time slots: Tue Mar 2 at 10:00AM PT or Wed Mar 3 at 2:00PM PT. Let me know which works and I'll send an invite.

Attachment: tech-checklist.md (SE checklist & test infra notes)

— Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer (ML Infrastructure)
Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Subject: Re: [MAP Kickoff] Joint evaluation playbook & technical handoff — Bluefin Analytics

Thanks Stephanie and Marcus — looping in Alex (our engineering lead) and Ruth (platform security). Alex will own the technical coordination. A few constraints / asks on our side:

- Alex Gomez (alex.gomez@bluefin.ai) will be the engineering lead and will invite one SWE (TBD) to the kickoff.
- Security: we need SOC 2 Type II evidence and a brief summary of how audit logs and KMS integrations work. Ruth, can you add any items I miss?
- Data residency: production inference must stay in us-west-2; for the eval sandbox we're flexible but would prefer us-west-2 if possible.
- Eval dataset: rough size will be 20k rows of anonymized payloads; latency target is P95 <= 250ms for single-request workflows and throughput target of ~120 req/min. Please confirm whether those are attainable in your Dedicated offering or via hosted variants.

We can do Tue Mar 2 10:00AM PT — that works for Alex and me. I'll accept once Marcus sends the invite. I've attached our internal security questionnaire so your security team can review.

Attachment: security-questionnaire-bluefin.xlsx

Best,
Sam Keller
